title: Keep a whole number
summary: Objective-C: Keep a whole number. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: An int stores a whole number. %d tells printf where to place it.
learningObjectives: Keep a whole number with Objective-C

blocks.text: On a Mac with Xcode command-line tools, save lesson.m. Run clang -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation lesson.m -o lesson, then ./lesson.

blocks.title: Keep a whole number

blocks.text: The int stores 3. The %d slot receives its sum with 2.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Match the print format to the number type.
